systems.name: p10-052588 · 10 cubes
systems.note: Lattice Heesch number: one; a full touching-tile first corona exists, and a complete second-corona exclusion is independently checked. The historical voxel-distance radii used a different convention.

systems.name: p10-052670 · 10 cubes
systems.note: Lattice Heesch number: zero; no full face/edge/vertex first corona. The old radius-one witness covered a voxel-distance window, not a touching-tile corona.

systems.name: Nonacube cross · two-unit arms
systems.note: Nine cubes in a planar cross. Exactly one complete lattice corona is possible: a first corona is verified and a checked SAT proof rules out two. Integer translations, cubic rotations, full face/edge/vertex surrounds; no topological-ball requirement. Watch the complete recorded search in the evidence viewer.

systems.name: Chair44 · centered relief
systems.note: Exact chamber occupancy and rational cube volumes. Centered apexes and joined dents; no angle rounding. Translations by whole original small cubes. Aperiodicity of this geometric version is unproved.

systems.name: Hat prism
systems.note: Single slab on the index-3 A₂ sublattice. Cap weights are doubled: interior t = 1, rim values are planar angles. Six in-plane rotations; reflected tiles are optional.

systems.name: Turtle prism
systems.note: Single slab using the Turtle demo’s index-3 point domain. Each cap retains 11 boundary vertices and 2 interior points. Interior t = 1; rim values are planar angles.

systems.name: Buckled ring
systems.note: The reference screen found small periodic and isohedral point certificates. Retained as a nonconvex search stress control, not a nonperiodic example.

systems.name: Twisted H

systems.name: Reinhardt tuning fork
systems.note: Large nonconvex support. The reference eight-copy periodic and isohedral probes remained unknown within two seconds. This is a bounded miss, not aperiodicity.

systems.name: 16-vertex lattice tile
systems.note: Known periodic control: 64 proper-rotation copies in a 12³ cell; an eight-copy motif is available with reflections. It is not a hard nonperiodic example.
